The Framework

Five steps inward.

A progression, not a checklist. Each step unlocks the next — building presence into clarity into integration.

01Free • Entry Point

ARRIVE

Begin where you are. A gentle orientation into presence, breath, and intention. No pressure to perform — just arrive.

02Foundation

GROUND

Root your attention in the body. Sensory check-ins and grounding prompts to move out of mental spiraling and into stability.

03Clarity

NAME

Give language to what is alive. Guided reflection to identify emotions, patterns, and unspoken needs without judgment.

04Insight

DEFINE

Distill what matters. Transform scattered thoughts into clear commitments, values, and next aligned actions.

05Integration

SEAL

Close the loop with intention. A sealing practice to carry your reflection forward — anchored, not abandoned.
